title: A heptadecanuclear MnIII9DyIII8 cluster derived from triethanolamine with two edge sharing supertetrahedra as the core and displaying SMM behaviour

material_class.structural_family: heptadecanuclear Mn9Dy8 cluster with two edge-sharing Mn5Dy5 supertetrahedra

synthesis.procedure: Mn(NO3)2·4H2O (0.25 g, 1 mmol) and Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.45 g, 1 mmol) were dissolved in MeOH–MeCN (15/5 mL), followed by addition of triethanolamine (0.13 mL, 1 mmol), sodium acetate (0.08 g, 1 mmol) and triethylamine (0.55 mL, 4 mmol) to give a deep brown solution. The mixture was stirred for 8 h. Brown crystals of 1 were isolated in 15% yield after slow diffusion of diethyl ether into the solution over two weeks.
synthesis.time: stirred 8 h; crystallization over two weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by slow diethyl ether diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Brown crystals isolated after slow diffusion of diethyl ether into the stirred solution over two weeks.

properties.summary: DC susceptibility of 1 (Vaseline mull, 2–300 K, 1 T, 0.1 T and 0.0085 T) shows room-temperature χMT = 132.16 cm3 mol−1 K (expected 140.36 cm3 mol−1 K for nine uncoupled MnIII S=2 and eight DyIII ions). χMT remains roughly constant then rises below 25 K with field dependence, reaching 211.2 cm3 mol−1 K at 3 K and 85 G before dropping at the lowest T, consistent with weak intermolecular antiferromagnetic interactions. Non-zero χM″ versus T indicates probable SMM behaviour.

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: room temperature; DC susceptibility, microcrystalline sample in Vaseline mull

measurements.name: χMT (spin-only expected)
measurements.conditions: nine uncoupled MnIII (S=2, g=2) plus eight DyIII (6H15/2, C=14.17 cm3 mol−1 K)

measurements.name: χMT maximum
measurements.conditions: 3 K, 85 G; DC fields 1 T, 0.1 T and 0.0085 T over 2–300 K

measurements.name: out-of-phase AC susceptibility / SMM behaviour
measurements.value: non-zero χM″ vs T; probable SMM
